trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Full-context read of rem:beta-stability-interpretation (derivation, verification, 3-row limiting table). Re-derived the whole thing: the FINAL formula p = A/(2 + a_C A^{2/3}/(2 a_A)) is the standard SEMF valley-of-stability result and is correct, but the two intermediate displays drop the factor 4 that d/dZ of the asymmetry term -a_A (A-2Z)^2/A supplies - with the 4 restored they yield the stated p, without it they yield A/(2 + 2 a_C A^{2/3}/a_A), four times the wrong correction (reported). Recomputed a_C = (q0 - 1/q0) * 3.334 = 0.697007 (matches 0.697). Evaluated the formula over a 30-nuclide stable sample (C-12 to Bi-209): mean |delta n| = 0.62, max 1.92, so the quoted 1.4 is if anything pessimistic; n*/p runs 1.08 (A=12) to 1.53 (A=208), 1.57 at A=238, matching the table's 1.0-1.6. The q->1 and q->infinity rows follow correctly from a_C = (q-1/q) lambda_C.
